patch_description: This block uses independent RY rotations to convert the diagonal IsingZZ feature phases into measurable population differences, followed by a Möbius-ladder CZ network. The topology combines an eight-qubit ring with four opposite-qubit links, providing short- and long-range mixing without trainable entanglers. A final independent RY layer performs local readout adaptation. Using only 16 parameters per block improves parameter efficiency and limits overfitting while retaining qubit-specific expressivity.
